04 / OUR LEADERSHIP

Experience behind
every conversation.

Chief Iniobong S. Jackson

PRINCIPAL CONSULTANT / CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER

Chief Jackson’s career spans international trade, export promotion, shipping and free zone policy. He has represented Nigerian manufacturers on the governing council of the Oil and Gas Free Zones Authority and served on the board of the Nigerian Export Promotion Council.
